notes:
Account snapshot:
- Company: Axiom Lattice Systems — enterprise search platform for legal and financial archives. Aggressive scale requirements: current pilot indexes ~250M vectors, target production 500M-1.2B vectors across multilingual corpora.
- Primary workload: embeddings + dense retrieval with a supervised neural reranker layered on top (top-K rerankers). Use-case: enterprise RAG for legal search and contract analysis, high recall + precise ranking.
- Latency / throughput targets: p95 end-to-end <120ms for single-question vertical queries (re-rank included) at 500-1,000 QPS baseline; burst to 2k QPS. P50 target <40ms.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement target cost-per-query <= $0.0006 (embeddings+retrieval+rerank amortized). ROI critical — must demonstrate <= 40% increase over current raw retrieval cost while improving precision.
- Model preferences: open/quantized embedding models; reranker can be a finetuned encoder-decoder or cross-encoder, willing to host custom reranker in Dedicated/Private. Looking for Redwood suggestions on quantization and model selection.
- Architecture asks: continuous/incremental index updates (daily delta ingest), batched bulk ingest (100M+ vectors ingestion plan), prefix/KV caching to reduce repeated cost on popular docs, automatic fallback routing across regions, and warm KV cache behavior for reranker context windows.
- POC details: 30-day POC started 2026-02-10. Milestones: initial ingest (50M) completed 2026-02-20; high-QPS synthetic load test 2026-02-28 (saw instability in shard allocation at 12 nodes); reranker integration demo 2026-03-02 (passed functional checks).
- Observations from POC so far: batching yields 3-4x cost improvement when batch size >=64; however cold cache queries are heavy. Prefers aggressive caching + prefix reuse. Disk footprint estimates: ~850M vectors (float16/quantized) -> planning for 1.5-2PB effective storage across replicas.
- Security & compliance: legal demands data residency for EU clients, strict KMS keys per tenant, full audit log retention 7 years for select customers. Redwood Private + HSM integration requested in RFP.
- Quotes from stakeholders: "We need predictable unit economics at scale — if cost is unbounded we can’t go to market" — Head of Product.
- Competition: evaluating Pinecone for ops simplicity, Vespa for low-latency customizable ranking, building an internal alternative too.
- Commercial: AE (Samira) sent formal pricing deck 2026-02-25; procurement requires 3 vendor comparisons. Revenue path: committed Dedicated pool + Professional Services for migration and indexing.
- Next steps: finish full-scale benchmark (target 500M synthetic index) by 2026-03-22; deliver detailed per-query cost breakdown and recommended batching/quantization profiles; legal to review drafted DPA (drive link above).
- Short-term ask from SE: show KV cache warm-up strategy and cold-start median latency with 10% hot-doc distribution. Also request for automated rollback policy if reranker causes quality regression.
- Internal CRM fragments: "POC instability when shards uneven; request autoscaler tweak"; "Procurement wants hard cap on per-query spend"; "Customer prefers nonproprietary embedding formats".
- Links to artifacts: POC logs (drive), Fireflies call notes attached.
